nodes.body: Review follow-up: a retained worker that fails its first task and immediately retires can still persist its cold startup graph during teardown. Flushing only at retirement would remain on that same teardown critical path. This is retained as a P2 follow-up; the current change drains main, writer-worker imports, and normal retained-worker idle points during their active lifetime. No data-loss or authority issue is involved.
